query:
select
display_id as "Patient ID",
first_name as "First name",
last_name as "Last name",
to_char(date_of_birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date of birth",
age as "Age",
sex as "Sex",
village as "Village",
facility as "Facility",
department as "Department",
location_group as "Area",
location as "Location",
to_char(((vaccination_date at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Vaccination date",
vaccine_category as "Vaccine category",
vaccine_name as "Vaccine name",
vaccine_brand as "If category of Other, Vaccine brand",
disease as "If category of Other, Disease",
vaccine_status as "Vaccine status",
vaccine_schedule as "Schedule",
batch as "Batch",
given_by as "Given by",
recorded_by as "Recorded by",
circumstances as "If given elsewhere, Circumstances",
given_elsewhere_by as "If given elsewhere, Country",
not_given_clinician as "If not given, Supervising clinician",
not_given_reason as "If not given, Reason not given"
from "reporting"."ds__vaccinations"
where
vaccine_status in ('Given', 'Not Given')
and
((vaccination_date at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))
>= 
:fromDate
and
((vaccination_date at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))
<= 
:toDate
and
case
when 
:villageId is null then true
else village_id = 
:villageId
end
and
case
when 
:facilityId is null then true
else facility_id = 
:facilityId
end
and
case
when 
:category is null then true
else vaccine_category = 
:category
end
and
case
when 
:vaccine is null then true
else vaccine_name = 
:vaccine
end
order by vaccination_date, last_name, first_name
name: Vaccine line list
notes:
This report generates a list of all patients that have had a vaccination recorded for the selected parameters. Patients are listed alphabetically by last name and date of vaccination in chronological order. 

The report includes vaccinations with statuses of both 'Given' and 'Not given', and each vaccination recorded is listed on a single row. If a vaccination was initially recorded as 'Not given' and is later marked as 'Given', only the vaccination record with a status of 'Given' will be included in the report.
